notes: I found no award prices, only tender notices. Osaka U publishes tender notices (公告) with quantities, such as NovaSeq X 25B-300 ×6 (20104706), 6000 S2 ×9 and X 10B ×10 (notice PDF created 24 Jan 2024, opening 6 Feb 2024). Those notices show no winner, contract amount, reserve price or award ratio. I did not open the Kyoto kohyo PDF or any Osaka award-result page. Two searches, one fetch of the Osaka notice PDF and one more search turned up no 25B unit-price series. Further notices turned up in search, but I did not open them: R7-11-27, R7-3-26 (a 19-item NovaSeq X Plus flow-cell tender for FY2025), R6-12-25, R6-6-27 and R5-12-26. The WebFetch tool returned the PDF only as binary, so I could not read it. Award disclosure is probably split into a separate listing, and search does not surface it.
how_to_mine: Download the Osaka U PDFs listed in notes into an empty directory and extract text with pdftotext or python -I pypdf. Check whether the notices state a reserve price. Then look on osaka-u.ac.jp (ja/guide/publications/cyoutatu) for a 落札結果 or 契約情報 listing, and on the Kyoto, Tokyo, Nagoya, RIKEN, NIG and Tohoku monthly 契約の公表 PDFs (exceeding ¥1M or ¥2.5M). Search each for イルミナ, NovaSeq and 25B, or for the distributors (和研薬, フナコシ, 日本ジェネティクス, アズサイエンス). Where the disclosure lists contracts per item or per set, compute yen per kit by year. Also try p-portal.go.jp for 落札情報.
